title: Threat Catalog Schema
description: Validates substrate-authored threat catalogs under governance-commons/catalogs/threats/. Threat catalogs are review-cadence reference catalogs (not on the draft/stable lifecycle); they enumerate an external threat taxonomy as substrate-original paraphrase, keyed by the upstream item identifier. The five catalogs use three top-level collection shapes (categories for STRIDE, threats for the OWASP taxonomies, techniques for MITRE ATLAS); this schema validates the shared structure (a metadata block plus at least one collection of identified items) without constraining the per-taxonomy item fields. Schema is at draft lifecycle status; it rides to stable with its threat-catalog consumers on a future cooling-off per the schema-rides-content precedent.

x-governance-commons.author: myoung
x-governance-commons.ai-assistance: AI drafted to close the threat-catalog validation gap that validate-catalogs.sh explicitly defers. The schema was derived from the five existing threat catalogs (stride, owasp-llm-top10, owasp-agentic-asi-2026, owasp-agentic-skills-top10, mitre-atlas) after the stride and asi catalogs were repaired from malformed to valid YAML in the same 1.0.1 corrections release. The schema validates shared structure only; it does not manufacture per-taxonomy item constraints the catalogs do not already share.
x-governance-commons.validation-notes: Validated against all five threat catalogs in catalogs/threats/ at authoring (2026-06-05). The schema requires a metadata block with catalog_id, catalog_name, and schema_version, and at least one item collection (categories, threats, or techniques) whose items each carry id and name. Top-level and metadata additionalProperties are open to tolerate per-catalog fields (usage_note, upstream_taxonomy_alias, full_matrix_url, applies_to, and similar). Promotion to stable follows the schema-rides-content Path A precedent (decisions 14, 17, 22): the schema flips draft to stable alongside a future threat-catalog content event after the Charter cooling-off, with no schema content change expected.
